items.note: 21 of 22 FR-01.10/FR-01.18 ACs bound to existing, real, passing tests via @pytest.mark.covers tags; the remaining AC06 is recorded unbound with an evidenced spec-vs-implementation discrepancy rather than a forced proxy binding, per the sub-iterate spec's own binding constraint.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: This unit is a pure test-tagging exercise (0 new production code paths, 0 new test harnesses) — no new error-handling surface was introduced.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No runtime code changed; tagging has zero runtime performance impact.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: All touched files verified at or under their applicable line cap (bloat-baselined files held exactly at their grandfathered `current`; non-baselined files held at exactly 300) via wc -l after every edit; anti_ratchet_check.py exits clean.
